results.title: Goodwill Kentucky opens applications for trades pathway program in Bowling Green
results.description: BOWLING GREEN, Ky. – Goodwill Kentucky says it is accepting applications for its next Construction and Skilled Trades Pathway Cohort in Bowling Green. According to Goodwill Kentucky, the program provides local job seekers with free, hands-on training for in-demand careers in the skilled trades.
